title: Figure 16. Atlas IIAS Mode-5 Ship-Hit Contours with A = 3.00
description: Contour plot of "Crossrange Distance (nm)" versus "Downrange Distance (nm)" showing nested teardrop-shaped Mode-5 ship-hit probability contours at 10^-5 and 10^-6. In-plot labels read "Atlas IIAS," "Mode 5 P_I," and "B = 1,000, A = 3.00." The outer 10^-6 contour extends about 15 nm downrange.
